Recommended actions include blocking card C05061-K1 (awaiting L1 approval) and filing a report (awaiting L2 approval).

sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report documents an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case AC-HHF-001. The activity involves customer C05061 holding credit card C05061-K1, operating via new device profiles RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL and RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for tablet | 1920x1080, which share anonymous proxy telemetry with 13 connected cards. On 2017-01-12 at 07:08, transaction 3660106 for $850.28 was conducted online in billing region 492.0 under product code C using device profile RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL. On 2017-01-13 at 22:09, transaction 3660107 for $890.79 was conducted online in billing region 264.0 under product code C using device profile RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for tablet | 1920x1080. On 2017-01-14 at 20:25, transaction 3660108 for $447.95 was conducted online in billing region 492.0 under product code C using device profile RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL. This online activity totaling $2,189.02 deviates significantly from the cardholder's baseline as of opening, which comprised 119 prior transactions with a median amount of $134.93 and a modal region of 181.0. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card (4 earlier closed case(s), none reported); closed cases CC-3791 on the same device profile or connected cards were confirmed fraud with reports filed. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. In case AC-HHF-001, opened 2017-01-15, internal case creation, analyst escalation, and monitoring of connected cards were executed, while a block of card C05061-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this filing is recommended for fraud-manager approval.
